gre_general.value: GRE General Test (minimum 280 combined Verbal + Quantitative; valid 5 years; code 6570) is required, unless waived for an engineering bachelor's GPA > 3.0 or an engineering master's GPA of 3.25.
gre_general.quote: GRE test scores of 280 for the Verbal Reasoning and Quantitative Reasoning examinations. Students who have a GRE score older than 5 years will need to re-take the GRE. A waiver of the GRE requirement will be granted to applicants who show proof of completing an undergraduate degree in engineering with an undergraduate GPA above a 3.0 | degree in engineering with graduate GPA of 3.25. GRE School Code: 6570.

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Materials Science & Engineering; ETS offers Subject Tests only in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Subject Tests in Mathematics, Physics and Psychology measure undergraduate achievement in a particular field of study

supervisor.value: Catalog admission requirements do not state whether securing a supervisor is required before admission.

funding.value: Full-time students are eligible for competitive university assistantships (0.5 FTE, 20 hrs/wk; minimum $1,250/month or $15,000/year for GTA/GRA, $2,400/month or $28,800/year for doctoral Associate Instructors, eligible for non-resident tuition waiver), plus UTRGV Graduate Select Scholarship up to $1,000.
funding.quote: The program may accept part-time students; however, only full-time students are eligible for assistantships.

also.quote: Assistantships give students the opportunity to work on campus (up to 20-hour work weeks). | Please visit with your graduate program director about the different assistantships available in your field of study. | careers.utrgv.edu for available graduate assistantship positions. | Eligible for Non-Resident Tuition Waiver: Yes | 10047 – Graduate Teaching Assistant $1,250 $15,000 $11,250 $3,750 | 10095 – Graduate Research Assistant $1,250 $15,000 $11,250 $3,750 | 10064 – Graduate Associate Instructor (doctoral level) $2,400 $28,800 $21,600 $7,200
Get up to $1,000 for your graduate education with the UTRGV Graduate Select Scholarship.

entry_route.value: Admits bachelor's holders (75 credit hours), non-thesis master's holders (65 hours), and thesis master's holders (54 hours) with >= 3.0 GPA.
entry_route.quote: Students admitted with a bachelor's degree will complete a minimum of 75 hours to earn the PhD in MSE.

notes: Materials Science and Engineering Ph.D. in the Department of Mechanical Engineering, featuring specialization in nanofibers, polymers, ceramics, and composites.
